ic_name: TIA/EIA-485 (RS-485 via TI SLLA272C Design Guide)

differential_bit_waveform.logical_one_mark: V_A > V_B; V_AB = V_A - V_B > +200 mV at any receiver across the common-mode range. Driver-side minimum |V_AB| = 1.5 V into 54-ohm test load.
differential_bit_waveform.logical_zero_space: V_A < V_B; V_AB < -200 mV at any receiver.
differential_bit_waveform.idle: All drivers tri-stated; V_AB driven > +200 mV by failsafe biasing → receiver R = HIGH = mark.

driver_rise_time_vs_stub_table.note: Drivers with longer rise times tolerate longer stubs and produce less device-generated EMI.

variables.v: signal velocity of cable as factor of c (typ 0.78)

cable_length_vs_data_rate_regions.region: Section 1 — high data rate / short cable
cable_length_vs_data_rate_regions.rule: Line losses negligible; data rate limited by driver rise time. Standard recommends 10 Mbps; modern parts reach 40 Mbps.
Line losses matter; rule-of-thumb length [m] × rate [bps] < 10^7 (conservative).

cable_length_vs_data_rate_regions.region: Section 3 — long cable / low data rate
cable_length_vs_data_rate_regions.rule: Cable resistance dominates; resistance approaches R_T and attenuates signal by -6 dB. For 22 AWG 120-ohm UTP this happens at ~1200 m.

minimum_node_spacing_curves.parameter: Lumped load capacitance C_L per node (pF)

example_curves.shape: lowest curve — nodes can be closely spaced

failsafe_biasing_waveform.idle_VAB_target: ≥ 200 mV + V_noise on an undriven bus
failsafe_biasing_waveform.RB_topology: Pull-up resistor R_B from line A to +V_BUS at each end + pull-down resistor R_B from line B to GND at each end; in series with termination R_T.

design_pitfalls: Direct ground-wire return — large ground-loop current couples GPD noise into data lines.
Resistor-bonded ground separation — reduces loop current but still sensitive to induced noise.
Signal + supply galvanic isolation — robust to multi-kilovolt GPDs and the recommended long-distance approach.

direction_control_timing_half_duplex.TX_setup: DE asserts before first start-bit edge; software waits for transceiver tDE_to_drive propagation delay.
direction_control_timing_half_duplex.TX_hold: DE held asserted until last stop bit has fully exited the driver; tail length is implementation-specific.
direction_control_timing_half_duplex.RX_to_TX_gap: Application-layer protocol defines this (Modbus RTU: 3.5 character times of bus quietness).
